_comment: Approvals over MCP so the owner can be asked through VoiceOS. Same queue as the /operator web console - an escalation can be answered from either.

_tools.pending_approvals: what is waiting - works on every MCP client
_tools.watch_approvals: hold open and prompt via elicitation; degrades to conversational if the client lacks the capability

_caveat: An MCP server can only speak inside a tool call. VoiceOS must either hold watch_approvals open or be asked. On a live call the caller is on hold, so the /operator web page remains the reliable path.
